novels.title: The Coffee I Owed
novels.subtitle: She spilled coffee on a billionaire. He offered her $212,000 to pretend to love him for thirty days.

novels.title: The Billionaire's Divorce Papers
novels.subtitle: On my third anniversary, my husband had his assistant FedEx me the divorce papers. Three hours later, my grandmother died and left me two billion dollars.

novels.title: Hostage Heart
novels.subtitle: They took me from a Manhattan parking garage on a Wednesday night. The man who carried me to the South of France told me my husband had refused to negotiate.

novels.title: The Boss's Daughter
novels.subtitle: My father is the boss of South Boston. Conor has driven me home since I was thirteen. The wedding to a man I do not love is in three months.

novels.title: Nine Months Contract
novels.subtitle: "He needed a wife for his custody hearing. I needed ninety thousand dollars for my sister's chemotherapy. We signed."

novels.title: The Inheritance Clause
novels.subtitle: "I had forty-three days to find a husband. I called the only man I had ever trusted: the boy who'd been my best friend until the summer we both turned twenty-one."

novels.title: Green Card
novels.subtitle: "He offered me five hundred thousand to marry him. Three weeks later ICE was standing in our kitchen."

novels.title: Review Bombed
novels.subtitle: "His name was on 47 one-star reviews of my novel. My publisher said the fix was to date him publicly."

novels.title: My Grandmother's Wedding
novels.subtitle: "My 78-year-old grandmother was getting married for the third time. She demanded I bring a 'serious boyfriend.' I asked the coffee-shop regular I'd been mildly in love with since spring."
subtropes: secret-profession (barista hero is Dartmouth philosophy prof

novels.title: The Corner Office
novels.subtitle: "We started on the same day. In eighteen months, one of us would be partner."

novels.title: The System Lied
novels.subtitle: The System told me my class was Paladin. I was a Necromancer. By the time I figured it out, I had eleven corpses in my shed.

novels.title: Day One Stat Screen
novels.subtitle: "The infection landed at 6:42 AM. The stat screen appeared at 6:44. I had two minutes to read it before the first zombie reached my building."

novels.title: The Woman Downstairs
novels.subtitle: "I knew my husband was having an affair. I knew who with. What I did not know was that she was planning my murder, and that by the time I figured it out, I would be downstairs in her basement."
